gloss: to be absent; to miss (class, a meeting)

definitions.gloss: to be absent; to miss; to not attend
definitions.explanation: To fail to attend or be present at a scheduled event such as class, a meeting, or a ceremony.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{欠席|けっせき}します。
{風邪|かぜ}で{学校|がっこう}を{欠席|けっせき}した。
examples.english: I was absent from school because of a cold.

examples.japanese: {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}のため、{明日|あした}の{会議|かいぎ}を{欠席|けっせき}させていただきます。
examples.english: I will be absent from tomorrow's meeting due to poor health.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{三日間|みっかかん}{欠席|けっせき}している。
examples.english: She has been absent for three days.

notes:
A formal word for being absent from a scheduled event. Commonly used in school and workplace contexts. The noun form {欠席|けっせき} is used on its own in roll calls and attendance records.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}を{欠席|けっせき}する: to be absent from class
- {会議|かいぎ}を{欠席|けっせき}する: to be absent from a meeting
- {欠席届|けっせきとどけ}: absence notification
- {欠席|けっせき}{日数|にっすう}: number of days absent
- {無断|むだん}{欠席|けっせき}: unauthorized absence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {休|やす}む: to take a day off / be absent — more casual and broader; can mean resting or taking leave, not only being absent
- {出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend — the direct opposite of {欠席|けっせき}する
- {不在|ふざい}: absence — describes not being in a particular place rather than missing an event
